title: Event and Party Catering - Minnesnowii Shave Ice
description: Event and Party catering with Minnesnowii. Large or small, we can handle it all - our premium product pleases people perfectly!

sections.title: Event and Party Catering in Minneapolis, MN and the Twin Cities
body: Event and Party Catering with Minnesnowii Shave Ice will enhance any gathering. Public or private events, functions and festivals, large and small, we can serve them all.

From birthday parties and corporate rallies to the Minnesota State Fair, we can serve groups of any size. Whether you need a small booth setup, a full service cart, or a full-size trailer, we have you covered.
Submit your information on the Book an Event form below, and we will reach out to firm up the details.

sections.title: Event booking with Minnesnowii means the fun comes to you!
body: Tell us your event date, location, setting, and how many cups you need. We will follow up to confirm availability and put together a plan that fits your gathering.
